meta.method: WebSearch result snippets only (40 searches); no pages opened. No published pitch emails surfaced in any snippet, so every email is null. Nothing is pattern-guessed. Where the only source for a claim is a database or aggregator profile (cbinsights, caplight, altss, startupintros, crypto-fundraising.info, aifunding.me, thebigwhale), confidence is lowered.
meta.scope: Proprietary trading, HFT and market-making firms that are not crypto-native. Crypto-native firms (Wintermute, GSR, Cumberland, Jump Crypto, etc.) are excluded.

firms.arm: Tower Research Ventures (TRV)
firms.evidence: TRV led the $2M pre-seed round of CaseBlink, an AI legal-tech startup, in March 2025. TRV's page says it invests from incubation to seed and has led seed rounds in Guard Owl, Assembli and CaseBlink.

Guard Owl, seed led by TRV (year not in snippet)
Assembli, seed led by TRV (year not in snippet)
firms.partner: Jared Young, Director of Venture Capital, leads the venture business. The team also includes Pietro Decio and Andrew McKinzie (tower-research.com/ventures).
firms.why: Invests from incubation to seed and focuses on AI/ML, fintech and developer infrastructure. It leads pre-seed rounds, so a 3-week-old company fits its stage. TRV is also hiring a 'Staff AI Engineer - Tower Research Ventures', which shows an AI build focus. The HFT DNA matches founders from Jane Street, Citadel and Millennium. One of the two closest matches to the SimReal brief.

SGE itself is growth stage (Series B+), so approach the SIG team that did the Deccan deal.
